implementation.name: ao486
implementation.notes: License: BSD-2-Clause for the core. https://github.com/alfikpl/ao486/blob/master/LICENSE is explicitly scoped -- "All files in the following directories: rtl, ao486_tool, sim are licensed under the BSD license" followed by the two-condition BSD text (Copyright (c) 2014, Aleksander Osman) -- while bochs486/ and bochsDevs/ are LGPL code taken from the Bochs project and some sd/ binaries come from FreeDOS and Bochs. license_id therefore describes rtl/ only, which is the path recorded here. accuracy_id behavioral: the README describes a new 4-stage pipelined microarchitecture "modeled and tested based on the Bochs software x86 implementation" implementing all 486 instructions, i.e. functional rather than timing fidelity. No implementation_chip row: no 486-class x86 part is catalogued under data/chip/.
